definitions.explanation: A person who looks after a warehouse — receiving deliveries, managing inventory, and watching over stored goods. Also the Japanese name of the puzzle video game known internationally as Sokoban.

examples.japanese: {倉庫番|そうこばん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work as a warehouse keeper.

examples.japanese: {倉庫番|そうこばん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The warehouseman is also in charge of inventory management.

examples.japanese: 「{倉庫番|そうこばん}」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}して→押す：02854_osu⟧⟦{所定|しょてい}→所定：12938_shotei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦パズル→パズル：05417_pazuru⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧だ。
examples.english: Sokoban is a puzzle game in which you push boxes to designated spots.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧ (warehouse) + ⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧ (watch, guard duty). The 〜⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧ suffix indicates someone on duty watching a place: ⟦{留守番|るすばん}→留守番：15546_rusuban⟧ (house-sitter), {店番|みせばん} (shop minder).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {倉庫番|そうこばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to work as a warehouse keeper
- {倉庫番|そうこばん}⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧: warehouse-keeper role
- {倉庫番|そうこばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧: the Sokoban game

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧{係|がかり}: warehouse staff — emphasizes assignment to the role
- ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧: inventory manager — more formal/modern job title
